items.title: runCompletenessCritic(input, runCritic) injected-seam critic invocation returning raw unprivileged Finding[], in core/adversarial-review-critic.ts
items.context: New module importing S0 (core/adversarial-review.js: CompletenessCriticInput{change,confirmedFindings}, Finding). runCompletenessCritic(input: CompletenessCriticInput, runCritic: (input: CompletenessCriticInput)=>Finding[]): Finding[] applies the injected runCritic to {change, confirmedFindings} and returns its Finding[] UNCHANGED (the critic output is raw + unprivileged per §2.4 — it re-enters S2 verification, which is S4 orchestration, NOT here). The critic seam only ever receives the CONFIRMED findings + the change (never raw lens findings). Optionally a convenience runCompletenessCriticOn(change, confirmedFindings, runCritic). Pure pass-through; no I/O.

happy.desc: runCompletenessCritic({change,confirmedFindings}, fakeRunCritic) where fakeRunCritic returns a planted Finding[] -> returns exactly those findings unchanged (referential identity or deep-equal) -> proves pure pass-through; WHY: the critic output is raw+unprivileged per S2.4, no transformation allowed

runCompletenessCriticOn(change, confirmedFindings, fakeRunCritic) convenience wrapper -> returns the same result as runCompletenessCritic({change,confirmedFindings}, fakeRunCritic); WHY: covers optional convenience form

edge.desc: runCompletenessCritic({change:"", confirmedFindings:[]}, fakeRunCritic) where fakeRunCritic returns [] -> returns []; WHY: empty-confirmedFindings boundary -- critic must still be called even when the verified set is empty (no short-circuit)
runCompletenessCritic where fakeRunCritic returns a large array (e.g. 50 findings) -> all 50 returned unchanged; WHY: no truncation or filtering on the output side

adversarial.desc: fakeRunCritic spy records its received argument -> must be exactly {change, confirmedFindings} (the two-field CompletenessCriticInput shape), NOT any superset or raw lens data -> the critic seam never leaks unverified findings; WHY: decision pre-mortem risk (a) -- critic must only receive the CONFIRMED set

runCompletenessCritic where fakeRunCritic mutates the input (e.g. pushes to confirmedFindings) -> the mutation is visible to the caller (pass-through semantics, no defensive copy) OR the function protects the input (document which); WHY: clarifies mutation contract and prevents silent data corruption

runCompletenessCritic where fakeRunCritic returns findings with extra fields beyond Finding schema -> those extra fields are preserved in the returned array (pass-through, not schema-filtered); WHY: ensures no accidental stripping of data the S2 verifier might need

items.title: COMPLETENESS_CRITIC_DESC_TAG + CRITIC_PROVENANCE_RECOMMENDED_LANES constants (§4.3)
items.context: COMPLETENESS_CRITIC_DESC_TAG='[completeness-critic]' (the provenance prefix carried in --desc, NOT --agent). CRITIC_PROVENANCE_RECOMMENDED_LANES=['lattice-review-quality','lattice-review-behavior'] as const (the §4.3 recommended real lanes for critic findings; a confirmed critic finding must be recorded under a real lattice-review-* lane because reviewer-evidence only counts when agent.startsWith('lattice-review-') and there is no lattice-review-completeness lane). Document WHY the tag goes in desc not agent.

happy.desc: COMPLETENESS_CRITIC_DESC_TAG === "[completeness-critic]" (exact string, including brackets); WHY: the desc prefix is the MVP provenance marker per S4.3 -- any drift breaks provenance parsing

CRITIC_PROVENANCE_RECOMMENDED_LANES is a readonly tuple containing exactly ["lattice-review-quality","lattice-review-behavior"] in that order; WHY: these are the only two recommended real lanes for critic findings per S4.3

every entry in CRITIC_PROVENANCE_RECOMMENDED_LANES is a valid ReviewRunLane (present in REVIEW_RUN_LANES from review-run.ts); WHY: a recommended lane that is not a real lane would break the reviewRunId binding at finding_add time

edge.desc: CRITIC_PROVENANCE_RECOMMENDED_LANES is typed as const (readonly tuple) and cannot be mutated at runtime (push/pop/assignment rejected by compiler or frozen); WHY: prevents accidental runtime extension of the recommended set

COMPLETENESS_CRITIC_DESC_TAG does NOT start with "lattice-review-" -- it is a desc-only marker, never an agent value; WHY: confirms the tag is structurally unsuitable as an agent and cannot accidentally satisfy isReviewerAgent()

adversarial.desc: attempt to use COMPLETENESS_CRITIC_DESC_TAG as an agent value in isReviewerAgent(COMPLETENESS_CRITIC_DESC_TAG) -> returns false; WHY: decision pre-mortem risk (a) -- the tag must NEVER pass the reviewer-agent gate, confirming provenance goes in desc not agent

CRITIC_PROVENANCE_RECOMMENDED_LANES does NOT include "completeness-critic" or any non-lattice-review-* string; WHY: ensures the recommended lanes can never route a critic finding through a non-reviewer agent path

items.title: toCriticFindingAddArgs(finding,{reviewRunId,agent,category}) wraps S2 toFindingAddArgs + prefixes the [completeness-critic] desc tag; agent typed as a REAL ReviewRunLane
items.context: Imports S2 toFindingAddArgs + FindingAddArgs (core/adversarial-review-verifier.js) and ReviewRunLane (core/review-run.js, read-only). toCriticFindingAddArgs(finding: Finding, opts:{reviewRunId:string, agent:ReviewRunLane, category:FindingAddArgs['category']}): FindingAddArgs computes base=toFindingAddArgs(finding,opts) then returns {...base, desc: COMPLETENESS_CRITIC_DESC_TAG+' '+base.desc}. agent is typed ReviewRunLane so the compiler REJECTS 'completeness-critic' (a real lane only — §4.3). Severity is still the S2-mapped critical|high|medium|low (no abstract leak). Pure — no finding_add call (that is S4).

happy.desc: toCriticFindingAddArgs(finding,{reviewRunId:"run-1",agent:"lattice-review-quality",category:"adversarial"}) -> result.desc STARTS WITH "[completeness-critic] " (tag + space) followed by the S2 composeDesc(finding) output; WHY: decision pre-mortem risk (a) -- provenance MUST be in desc, not agent
toCriticFindingAddArgs result.agent === "lattice-review-quality" (the passed-in real lane, NOT "completeness-critic"); WHY: decision pre-mortem risk (a) -- agent stays a real lattice-review-* lane

toCriticFindingAddArgs result.severity === SEVERITY_TO_FINDING_KIND[finding.severity] for each abstract severity (BLOCKER->critical, MAJOR->high, MINOR->medium); WHY: decision pre-mortem risk (c) -- keeps the S2-mapped critical|high|medium|low, never the abstract BLOCKER/MAJOR/MINOR

toCriticFindingAddArgs result matches toFindingAddArgs(finding,opts) in every field EXCEPT desc (which has the prefix); WHY: toCriticFindingAddArgs is a thin wrapper, all other fields (files, category, reviewRunId, agent, severity) must pass through from S2

edge.desc: toCriticFindingAddArgs with agent:"lattice-review-behavior" -> result.agent === "lattice-review-behavior"; WHY: works for both recommended lanes, not just quality

toCriticFindingAddArgs with a finding whose title/issue/fix contain the tag string "[completeness-critic]" -> desc has exactly ONE prefix (not double-tagged); WHY: edge case where the finding text already contains the tag

toCriticFindingAddArgs result.severity is never "BLOCKER"|"MAJOR"|"MINOR" (the abstract set) for any input severity; WHY: confirms the S2 map is always applied, abstract severities never leak to FindingAddArgs

adversarial.desc: TypeScript compiler rejects toCriticFindingAddArgs(finding,{reviewRunId:"r",agent:"completeness-critic" as any,category:"happy"}) at compile time when agent is typed ReviewRunLane (not string) -- verify the type signature restricts agent to ReviewRunLane; WHY: decision pre-mortem risk (a) -- compiler-level enforcement that completeness-critic can never be the agent

toCriticFindingAddArgs result.desc never equals the bare composeDesc (without prefix) -- assert desc.length > composeDesc(finding).length; WHY: a regression that drops the prefix silently loses all critic provenance

toCriticFindingAddArgs with finding.severity set to an unexpected string (e.g. "LOW" which is not in FindingSeverity) -> either throws or produces undefined severity (documents the boundary); WHY: adversarial input -- ensures no silent pass-through of non-abstract severities that would bypass the S2 map

items.title: Hermetic smoke with a FAKE runCritic proving seam pass-through + provenance tagging; register in lattice.config.json
items.context: New packages/main/src/tasks/adversarial-review-critic-smoke.ts (check+counter, explicit literals). Assert: runCompletenessCritic with a fake runCritic that records its input and returns a planted Finding[] -> returns exactly those findings unchanged, and the fake received exactly {change, confirmedFindings} (the confirmed set, not raw); an empty confirmedFindings still calls the critic. toCriticFindingAddArgs(finding,{reviewRunId,agent:'lattice-review-quality',category}) -> desc STARTS WITH '[completeness-critic] ' followed by the S2 composeDesc; severity is the mapped critical|high|medium|low (NOT an abstract BLOCKER/MAJOR/MINOR); agent==='lattice-review-quality' (a real lane, never 'completeness-critic'); files/category/reviewRunId pass through; works for 'lattice-review-behavior' too. COMPLETENESS_CRITIC_DESC_TAG==='[completeness-critic]'. Register node packages/main/dist/tasks/adversarial-review-critic-smoke.js in lattice.config.json validate.commands.

happy.desc: smoke test: runCompletenessCritic with a FAKE runCritic that records its input and returns planted Finding[] -> asserts returned findings === planted findings (unchanged) AND the fake received exactly {change, confirmedFindings}; WHY: proves seam pass-through contract end-to-end

smoke test: toCriticFindingAddArgs(finding,{reviewRunId,agent:"lattice-review-quality",category}) -> asserts desc STARTS WITH "[completeness-critic] " AND agent === "lattice-review-quality" (never "completeness-critic") AND severity is the S2-mapped critical|high|medium|low; WHY: proves provenance tagging + agent-is-real-lane invariant
smoke test: COMPLETENESS_CRITIC_DESC_TAG === "[completeness-critic]" (explicit literal assertion); WHY: locks the constant value against drift
smoke test registered in lattice.config.json validate.commands as node packages/main/dist/tasks/adversarial-review-critic-smoke.js; WHY: ensures the test runs in CI/validate

edge.desc: smoke test: runCompletenessCritic with confirmedFindings:[] (empty confirmed set) -> fakeRunCritic is STILL called (no short-circuit); WHY: the critic must always run even when the verified set has zero findings

smoke test: toCriticFindingAddArgs with agent:"lattice-review-behavior" -> same invariants hold (desc prefix, real lane agent, mapped severity); WHY: proves both recommended lanes work, not just quality

adversarial.desc: smoke test: for every abstract severity (BLOCKER, MAJOR, MINOR), toCriticFindingAddArgs result.severity is NEVER the abstract string -- always one of critical|high|medium|low; WHY: decision pre-mortem risk (c) -- prevents abstract severity leak to the ledger

smoke test: toCriticFindingAddArgs result.files, result.category, result.reviewRunId all pass through identically from toFindingAddArgs -- the wrapper only changes desc; WHY: prevents silent field mutation or loss in the wrapper
smoke test uses check+counter pattern (explicit pass/fail count) and exits non-zero on any assertion failure; WHY: ensures lattice validate catches regressions rather than silently passing
